hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */supply-os-v1/*.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx) d="${f%%/frontend/*}/frontend"; [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/eslint" ] && (cd "$d" && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null) ;; esac; true
